connector.name: Green API WhatsApp
connector.registryDescription: MCP gateway for WhatsApp via Green API: messaging, contacts, groups and instance management.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.green-api.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.green-api. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
